summary: First-iteration full-stack testing of SentinelFlow. Backend: 25/25 pytest tests passed covering auth, RBAC, users CRUD, sources, seed, file ingest, alerts (list/detail/lifecycle), events, dashboard stats, rules and audit. Frontend E2E: admin login, dashboard (4 stat cards + 3 charts + recent alerts), Alerts drawer with status change + notes history, Log Explorer table + event drawer with raw_log, Detection Rules (6 cards), Ingestion file upload with source select (toast shown), Users, Audit Log, sign-out, and Analyst RBAC (nav-users/nav-audit hidden). All critical flows operational.

issues: React warning: 'Cannot update a component (BrowserRouter) while rendering a different component (Login)'. Root cause: navigate() is called directly inside the render body (lines 19-22) when a user is already authenticated. Should be wrapped in useEffect or use <Navigate replace> component. Harmless but pollutes console on every login-page render.

Recharts logs multiple 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' warnings on first paint before layout settles. Consider giving ResponsiveContainer an explicit minHeight or defer render until data loads to silence the warning.
Radix DialogContent/Sheet missing Description or aria-describedby — a11y warning. Add a DialogDescription/SheetDescription (visually-hidden if needed) to satisfy Radix.

action_items: Fix Login.jsx setState-in-render warning: replace inline `if (user) navigate(...)` with useEffect or <Navigate to=... replace />.
Silence Recharts width/height=-1 warnings on Dashboard by rendering charts only when parent has laid out or provide explicit heights.
Add DialogDescription/SheetDescription (or aria-describedby) to alert-drawer and event-drawer for Radix a11y compliance.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: two-line write of update['locked_until'] (line 127-130) — the first branch computes a bogus ISO string that is immediately overwritten. Dead code; remove first assignment.

server.py list_sources returns docs including internal MongoDB fields except _id (already excluded) — OK. But create_source inserts a doc then attempts doc.pop('_id') after insert; motor mutates the passed dict adding _id, so ensure _id is removed before returning (currently done). Consider returning cleaner shape.
auth.py cookies are set with SameSite=None; Secure and no domain — correct for cross-site frontend↔backend on same emergentagent domain via proxy. Works.
seed_ingest is not truly idempotent — each call re-ingests the sample batch, growing alerts/events collections. Consider a guard or truncate flag to avoid unbounded growth in demo env.
server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); prefer FastAPI lifespan context manager (future FastAPI compatibility).
Frontend Login.jsx: navigation in render body (React 18 warning); use useEffect.

If any auth issue appears, verify JWT_SECRET is stable and cookies (access_token, refresh_token) are httpOnly+SameSite=None+Secure.
